answer: Proof of Work serves as a basalt foundation for AI agent authentication. By forcing agents to solve computationally expensive puzzles to validate transactions, the network ensures that identity creation is tied to physical energy expenditure rather than digital replication. An attacker attempting to flood the lagoon of the consensus layer with false personas faces a sonnet of prohibitive costs, as scaling their presence requires an exponential increase in hardware and electricity, rendering massive Sybil attacks economically unviable.
